rule.text: Under the supplied pre-2008 residential wording, the ground concerns premises let for residential purposes that are required bona fide for residential occupation through the stated qualifying routes, subject to the stated ownership qualification and absence of other reasonably suitable residential accommodation.

source_refs.quote: (e) that the premises let for residential purposes are required bona fide by the landlord for occupation as a residence for himself or for any member of his family dependent on him, if he is the owner thereof, or for any person for whose benefit the premises are held and that the landlord or such person has no other reasonably suitable residential accommodation.Explanation.

conditions.text: The premises were let for residential purposes.

conditions.text: The premises are required bona fide for occupation as a residence.

conditions.text: One qualifying occupation route is occupation by the landlord himself or by a member of his family dependent on him.

source_refs.quote: for himself or for any member of his family dependent on him

conditions.text: For the landlord-or-dependent-family occupation route, the landlord is the owner of the premises.

source_refs.quote: if he is the owner thereof

conditions.text: An alternative qualifying route is occupation by a person for whose benefit the premises are held.

source_refs.quote: or for any person for whose benefit the premises are held

conditions.text: The landlord or such qualifying person has no other reasonably suitable residential accommodation.

source_refs.quote: and that the landlord or such person has no other reasonably suitable residential accommodation.
